name: Deliver the Thread
summary: Madame Eva sends ghost hair thread from Darkshire across Duskwood to Abercrombie near Raven Hill Cemetery. The hermit says he needs it to guard his hut from restless spirits.

sections.title: A Crossing in the Dark
sections.body: Madame Eva gives you a spool of Ghost Hair Thread, spun from hair gathered from the ghost Blind Mary. You carry it west through Duskwood, where spiders and undead roam. Abercrombie waits in his ramshackle shack just north of Raven Hill Cemetery.

sections.title: Threads of Life and Death
sections.body: Abercrombie says he will line his windows and doorframe with the spectral thread to keep out the wailing dead of Raven Hill. Madame Eva says ghost hair thread has many uses, including binding malevolent spirits and sewing the semblance of life into dead and inanimate matter. Abercrombie welcomes the spool with delight and sets his hidden craft in motion.

faq.answer: Ghost Hair Thread is an enchanted spool Madame Eva spins in Darkshire from hair gathered from the ghost Blind Mary. She says it can bind spirits or sew life into inanimate objects.
Abercrombie is a reclusive old man in a lonely shack just north of Raven Hill Cemetery. He appears frail and harmless, and says he fears the undead near his home.

faq.q: Why does Abercrombie claim he needs the thread?
faq.answer: Abercrombie says he will string ghost hair thread along his windows and doorways to ward off the ghouls and spirits roaming Duskwood.
Abercrombie lives in an isolated wooden shack north of Raven Hill Cemetery's main grounds, just off the western road through Duskwood.

faq.q: What happens after giving the thread to Abercrombie?
faq.answer: After Abercrombie receives the thread, he rewards you and complains of other pressing needs. He sends travelers after odd alchemical ingredients such as Zombie Juice.

faq.q: Does Madame Eva know what Abercrombie is up to?
faq.answer: Madame Eva does not accuse Abercrombie of foul play. She remarks that ghost hair thread can sew life into inanimate objects, showing she knows its necromantic potential, yet she fulfills the request without protest.

angles.text: Spinning spectral hair into usable spools blends needlecraft with hedge necromancy. The thread can stitch matter beyond the physical realm.
As a priest, you would usually turn to holy rites of the Light to ward a home against restless dead. Abercrombie's reliance on woven remnants of the dead points to a darker path.
As an Alliance traveler, you help carry aid from Darkshire through the dangerous western woods to an isolated hermit, while the Night Watch strains to guard the frontier.
